title: EAS Pulse
tagline: EAS Pulse is a Dune analytics dashboard built from scratch for the Superhack 2024 for all about Ethereum Attestation Service: attestation usage, daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly performance, revenue generation, and trends in the superchain and other blockchain networks.
description:
EAS Pulse is an analytics dashboard for all about Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) with the goal to made easy the discovery of attestation usage, trends and other insights in the super chain and other blockchain networks. 
In this dashboard there is an special emphasis on daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly performance. 

There is a highlight of the revenue generation and viability of one of the most promising attestation integration projects - Passport (formerly Gitcoin Passport) and one of the flagship integration of EAS. While Passport is a cross-chain integration, Coinbase Verifications has been leveraging this stack for a long time until the irruption of the Scroll Canvas Badges. 

The dashboard also showcases the Optimism Foundation, Clique, Praise and Attest Fest all of the them superchain attestoooors.

All queries in the dashboard are forkable and also found in the repo as SQL queries.
how_its_made: This project was built using SQL for querying Dune Analytics on different blockchain networks such as Optimism, Base, Linea, Scroll, Arbitrum, zkSync, Polygon and Ethereum. This dashboard does not  include data from Arbitrum Nova as it is not currently available in Dune Analytics.
